{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] '''manufacturing plant''' stood in the [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Alien Protection Zone]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Agents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Alien Combine]] in cooperation with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|entered]] one of the plant's warehouses posing as employees in an attempt to slip rigged memory cores into Imperial Center's central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system. Their purpoted ally from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Zekka Thyne]], sold them out, and an arriving group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] engaged them in a [[lightfight]].
